Most Honorable Lord Ravion,

Please forgive my audacity in writing this letter. I know I'm too insignificant for you to read my words, but I have to write them down anyway to express my thoughts.

From the moment you strode past me in the grand hall, I realized that some lights were too bright to go unnoticed. Your presence commanded admiration, your grace was unmatched, and your gaze... it took my breath away.

(Is this too much?)

Don't worry, I'm not expecting anything from you. Just know that you have a secret admirer out there... I hope this letter doesn't get thrown away!

(Is this too cringey? People don't write their love letters like this nowadays... Let me think it over again!)

尊敬的沙利叶殿下：

请原谅我的僭越，我知道自己微不足道，或许这封信永远不会被拆开，但若不写下这些字句，我的心绪便无处安放。

自您在王宫大殿中步履而过的那一刻起，我便明白，有些光芒即便不直视，也能在心头留下痕迹。您的气度令人敬仰，您的身姿如此优雅，而您的目光……您的目光令我屏息。
（这会不会太浮夸了……？）

总之，我不敢奢求什么，只是想让您知道，这个世界上，有人一直默默注视着您，敬仰您……希望这封信不会被丢掉！

（会不会太煽情了……现在已经不流行这种情书写法了……我再想想！）
